purpose: Separately preregistered first GLM max complete interaction after the retained Sol protocol failure. Same package semantics and immutable image. This does not replace the first run or diagnose its unseen response.
stopping_rule: Exactly one GLM max full attempt with 150 actions, 600 seconds/request and 3600 seconds/episode. No hints, silent retries or replacement; response-shape metadata is observational only.
decision: A clean delivery rejects this candidate as evidence of high difficulty. Task failure requires causal audit and fresh counterfactual execution using evidence accessible at the decision point. Infrastructure, observer and format failures do not establish cognitive difficulty. One failure is at most a candidate signal. Do not expand a family before this screen.
controls_reference: plan.json and control-evidence.json; identical package source hashes and image, no new control execution claimed
